row: The BC SPCA is a not-for-profit organization dedicated to protecting vulnerable animals and mobilizing communities so animals and people thrive together in British Columbia. Across the province, the BC SPCA provides a wide range of services for more than 32,000 injured, abused and homeless animals each year.
